spec.description: The story of the coffee cart: the backend says all is well, Faro shows what users actually hit.

spec.title: New sessions per minute
spec.description: How many visitors arrive per minute. Climbs with load.

spec.title: Page views and user actions per minute
spec.description: A user action groups a click with everything it caused: API calls, errors, DOM changes.

spec.title: Visitors by browser and OS
spec.description: Faro records the browser and OS of every session.

spec.expr: sum by (who) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="event"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | label_format who="{{.browser_name}} on {{.browser_os}}" [$__range]))

spec.title: Backend latency
spec.description: Server-side request duration. Compare with the web vitals above: users feel more than the server measures.

spec.title: Orders and failed checkouts per minute
spec.description: Business outcome of the traffic.

spec.title: Backend responses by status code
spec.description: What the server saw. Compare with the browser-side errors: some user-visible failures never appear here.

spec.title: Sessions
spec.description: New Faro sessions in the time range. A session is one visitor's visit.

spec.title: Top errors
spec.description: Most frequent distinct exceptions, grouped by type and message.

spec.expr: topk(8, sum by (err) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="exception"} | logfmt | label_format err="{{.type}}: {{.value}}" [$__range])))

spec.title: Recent frontend exceptions (expand a line for the resolved stack trace)
spec.description: Expand a line to see the stack trace. Source maps are applied by Alloy, so frames show source files and lines, not minified code.

spec.title: Backend errors (carry trace_id)
spec.description: Open a trace from the trace_id.

spec.title: Frustration signals per minute
spec.description: Rage clicks (repeated clicks), dead clicks (nothing happened) and error clicks (a click followed by an error). The backend sees none of these.

spec.title: Where users get frustrated
spec.description: Frustration grouped by the user action the person was attempting.

spec.expr: sum by (what) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="event"} |= "event_name=faro.frustration" | logfmt | label_format what=`{{ trimPrefix "faro.frustration." .event_name }} on {{.event_data_userActionName}}` [$__range]))

spec.title: Orders placed
spec.description: Backend metric coffee_cart.orders.placed.

spec.title: Web vitals (75th percentile)
spec.description: How fast pages feel to real browsers. Measured in the user's browser, so it includes everything between the click and the pixels. Headless test browsers on localhost are far faster than real users.

spec.title: Session timeline
spec.description: Events, errors and measurements for the chosen session, oldest first. Expand a line for every field.

spec.expr: {service_name="coffee-cart-frontend"} | logfmt | session_id=~"$sessionId" | event_name!~"faro.performance.*|faro.tracing.fetch" | line_format "{{.kind}}  {{.event_name}}{{.type}}  view={{.view_name}}  action={{.event_data_userActionName}}  user={{.user_username}}  session={{.session_id}}"

spec.title: Traces from this session
spec.description: Browser traces. Open one to see the click, the API call and the backend spans in one waterfall.

spec.title: What the server saw
spec.description: Share of API requests that returned a 5xx error: what a backend-only dashboard would show.

spec.title: What users hit
spec.description: Share of sessions that had at least one browser exception or frustrated click (rage, dead or error click). Measured per session, not per request, which is the point: a user feels a problem even when most requests succeed.

spec.title: Errors the backend never saw
spec.description: Browser exceptions that were not a failed API call: images that failed to load, JavaScript errors, bad data. Nothing in the backend telemetry shows these.

spec.title: Load: backend requests and new sessions per minute
spec.description: How busy the shop is. Compare with the trouble chart below to see whether problems follow load.

spec.title: Trouble per minute: the server's view and the users' view
spec.description: Blue is what the backend reports (5xx responses). Red and orange are what users hit in their browsers. Watch how often the user lines move without the blue one.

spec.title: Where user-visible errors came from
spec.description: Backend call failed: the browser got an error from the API. Browser only: the backend never knew (broken images, JavaScript errors, bad data).

spec.expr: sum by (source) (count_over_time({service_name="coffee-cart-frontend",kind="exception"} | logfmt | label_format source=`{{ if eq .type "ApiError" }}Backend call failed{{ else }}Browser only{{ end }}` [$__range]))

spec.title: The story: what the server saw vs what users hit
